explanation: The statement says the formula ⊤ is valid on any Kripke frame. Every notion in it comes from the library itself: `LO.Modal.Formula`, `Kripke.Frame` and the `ValidOnFrame` satisfaction relation `⊧`. Mathlib has no Kripke semantics for modal logic, so no Mathlib declaration can carry this content. The proof is just `simp` unfolding the library's own definitions. I did not search Mathlib, because none of these definitions exist there.
